_meanings:
.²1 Aggregation, union, composition.
.²2 Composition of words, a compound; (the principal kinds of compounds
 are four:-- {#dvandva, tatpuruza, bahuvrIhi#}, and {#avyayIBAva#} <ab>qq. vv.</ab>).
.²3 Reconciliation, composition of differences.
.²4 A collection, an assemblage; {#yadvavijYAtamivABUdityetAsAmeva devatAnAM#}
 {#samAsaH#} <ls>Ch. Up. 6. 4. 7</ls>.
.²5 Whole, totality.
.²6 Contraction, conciseness, brevity; {#eza samAsaH . sarvaTA pravezwavyaM#}
 {#kuntiBojasya kanyApuram#} <ls>Avimārakam 2</ls>; {#eza samAsaH, adyAsmi mahAsenaH#} <ls>Pratijñā. 2</ls>.
.²7 Euphonic

 combination ({#saMDi#}).
.²8 Completion, end; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> ({#samAsena, samAsataH#} means ‘in short’,
 ‘briefly’, ‘succinctly’; {#ezA Darmasya vo yoniH samAsena prakIrtitA#}
 <ls>Ms. 2. 25</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 20</ls>; {#iti kzetraM taTA jYAnaM jYeyaM coktaM samAsataH#}
 <ls>Bg. 13. 18</ls>; {#samAsataH SrUyatAm#} <ls>V. 2.</ls>)
supplying an ellipsis in a compound.
a part of a stanza proposed to be completed (= {#samasyA#} <ab>q. v.</ab>).

a figure of speech thus defined by Mammaṭa:-- {#paroktirBedakEH#}
 {#SlizwEH samAsoktiH#} <ls>K. P. 10</ls>.
